chunks: Amīr al-mu’minīn then said: So then extend your hand.
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali tell Kolayb to do when he inquired about his position?
ai.summary: In this brief yet significant exchange, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) instructs Kolayb al-Jarmi to extend his hand, a gesture often associated with the formalization of authority, the taking of an oath, or the confirmation of a pledge (bay'ah) regarding his stance in the Battle of the Camel. This moment highlights the Imam's direct engagement with his envoys, emphasizing the clarity and decisiveness of his position against the opponents of Jamal.
